description.name: Entry
description.text: Seven ranged attacks (0.90 each) capped at 19999, grant [Damage Cap +10000], [Dual Awoken Rogue Mode I (Thief (I))], [Twin Element Mode II (Wind, Poison)] and [Thief/Celerity Resonance +5% Boost] to the user

description.name: Dual Awoken Rogue Mode I (Thief (I))
description.text: Thief and Celerity abilities deal 5/10/15/20/30% more damage at ability rank 1/2/3/4/5, Thief and Celerity abilities trigger 2 additional times, cast speed x1.50/x2.00/x2.50/x3.00 and 5%/10%/15%/20% additional critical damage for equipped Thief and Celerity abilities after casting 1/2/3/4+ Thief or Celerity abilities

description.name: Twin Element Mode II (Wind, Poison)
description.text: Grants [Attach Wind with Stacking]/[Attach Poison with Stacking] after using a Wind/Poison ability

description.name: Thief/Celerity Resonance +5% Boost
description.text: Thief and Celerity abilities deal 5% more damage

description.name: Dual Shift
